text: Before beginning the experiment, 500.0 cm of 0.139 mol dm (COOH) (aq), solution X, is made.
The activated carbon is placed in an oven at 120 °C for three hours.
The experimental procedure involves the following steps.
step 1 Prepare 100.0 cm of 0.00556 mol dm (COOH) (aq) from solution X.
step 2 Transfer 50.0 cm of the 0.00556 mol dm (COOH) (aq) into a conical flask.
step 3 Add 0.500 g of activated carbon to the conical flask and start a stopwatch.
step 4 Shake the flask and immediately remove a 5.0 cm sample from the flask. Determine the
mass of non-adsorbed (COOH) in the sample using chromatography.
step 5 Repeat step 4 at suitable time intervals until there is no further change in the mass of
molar volume of gas V = 22.4 dm mol at s.t.p. (101 kPa and 273 K)
